content.introduction: The Federal Reserve Bank is open on July 3, 2026, but the Board of Governors is closed. The next FOMC meeting is scheduled for July 31, 2026. Federal Reserve staff do not speak publicly around FOMC meetings.

Federal Reserve staff, including those at the Chicago Fed, generally do not speak publicly between a week prior to the Saturday preceding a Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting and the Thursday following that meeting.
